changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'InProcessAuditField') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[InProcessAuditField]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ProcessUid] [uniqueidentifier], [Executionid] [int], Processdatetime datetime, ItemNumber int, Object varchar(50), ObjectId int, [FieldTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [FieldName] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Value] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [PreviousValue] [nvarchar](max) NULL, MaxAuditID int, ProcessID Varchar(20) CONSTRAINT [PK_InProcessAuditField] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ID] ASC ) ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_InProcessAuditField_ProcessUid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_InProcessAuditField_ProcessUid ON [api].[InProcessAuditField] ([ProcessUid],ItemNumber,ProcessID) INCLUDE (ID) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_InProcessAuditField_ProcessId-ProcessUid-FieldTypeId') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_InProcessAuditField_ProcessId-ProcessUid-FieldTypeId] ON [api].[InProcessAuditField] ([ProcessID], [ProcessUid], [FieldTypeID]) INCLUDE ([FieldName], [MaxAuditID], [ObjectId], [PreviousValue], [Value]) WITH (ONLINE = ON) END
